label: Compare candidates
title: Compare the homes you already found.
caption: Three recorded listings; source dates and unknown values stay visible.
ja: 検討中の候補から比較します。掲載時点と未取得の情報を区別します。

label: Import an image
title: Add a listing image. Inspect what was extracted.
caption: Live OCR and Gemini analysis; uncertain fields need confirmation.
ja: 図面を実際に解析します。読み取りが不確かな値は確認が必要です。

label: Import a listing link
title: Research a listing link across sources.
caption: A real SUUMO building URL; choose sourced fields before adding a candidate.
ja: SUUMOのリンクを調査し、出典を確認して候補に追加します。

label: Research missing rent
title: Look for missing rent without mixing up rooms.
caption: Fresh web research. Another unit's offer remains a reference, not a confirmed cost.
ja: 不足する月額をネットで再調査します。別室の募集は参考情報として扱います。

label: Ask AI and confirm
title: Let actual candidate differences guide the conversation.
caption: Live Gemini replies. A suggested priority is saved only after explicit confirmation.
ja: 実際のGemini応答で希望を整理します。提案は本人が確認してから保存します。

label: Check the commute
title: Choose a destination, then continue in Google Maps.
caption: Prefilled outbound / return routes. Set 08:00 arrival and 18:00 departure in Maps.
ja: 目的地を選び、入力済みのMapsリンクへ。朝8時到着・夕18時出発はMaps側で設定します。

label: Verify walking claims
title: Check the station and shopping against Maps.
caption: Live places and walking estimates are dated observations, not guarantees.
ja: 駅・買い物への徒歩情報をGoogle Mapsで照合します。取得日時付きの目安です。

label: Discover leisure
title: See nearby places before choosing what matters.
caption: Real parks, gyms and cafés. Confirm an interest and frequency from the results.
ja: 公園・ジム・カフェを検索し、結果を見て関心と頻度を確認します。

label: Search apartment reviews
title: Search the apartment, building, then nearby references.
caption: Live web search. No usable review means an empty result, not invented feedback.
ja: 部屋・建物・近隣の順で口コミを検索します。見つからなければ空欄のままです。

label: Compare weekly scenarios
title: Try a weekly routine with the information available.
caption: Confirm two commuting days. Unknown transit times stay unknown.
ja: 週2日の通勤を想定して確認します。未取得の所要時間は補いません。

label: Read the decision brief
title: Turn confirmed priorities into a useful brief.
caption: Your choices and open questions are assembled automatically.
ja: 確認した希望と未解決の質問をメモに自動でまとめます。

label: Export and share
title: Preview, download, and create an expiring share.
caption: Real HTML export and server-backed sharing. Only selected content leaves this browser.
ja: 内容を確認してHTML保存し、実際のAPIで期限付きリンクを作成します。

label: Run your own instance
title: Watch the recording. Deploy the complete app.
caption: Local live API recording. Deployment instructions are linked in the README.
ja: ローカル環境の実接続による録画です。完全なアプリのデプロイ手順はREADMEから参照できます。
